svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: One GRE repetition, coloured and boxed by the LogicBlock that wrote it
svg.desc: Lanes for RF, Gz, Gy, Gx, ADC and Label carry the waveforms of one spoiled gradient-echo repetition. Each module that produced them is drawn as a labelled box in its own colour: Excitation spans the RF and Gz lanes, PhaseEncode the Gy lane, CartesianLine the Gx and ADC lanes, and two spoilers the Gx and Gz lanes. Three of those boxes overlap across one short window on three axes. An outer box marks the whole repetition, GRE2DTR, which emits the LIN label itself. Along the bottom are the four pulseq blocks the compiler derived, their boundaries drawn as dashed lines through everything above.
